name: Lily Pad
description: Round lily pads with a wedge notched out of each, large and small ones floating together on still water.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { :before { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 4%; top: 4%; width: 92%; height: 92%; border-radius: 50%; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3)); -webkit-mask: conic-gradient(from 0deg at 50% 50%, #000 0 328deg, transparent 328deg 360deg); mask: conic-gradient(from 0deg at 50% 50%, #000 0 328deg, transparent 328deg 360deg); -webkit-transform: translate(@r(-8, 8)%, @r(-8, 8)%) rotate(@r(0, 360)deg) scale(@rn(0.5, 1.15, 3)); transform: translate(@r(-8, 8)%, @r(-8, 8)%) rotate(@r(0, 360)deg) scale(@rn(0.5, 1.15, 3)); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } :after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 60%; top: 60%; width: 34%; height: 34%; border-radius: 50%; background: @p(var(--color1), var(--color2), var(--color3)); -webkit-mask: conic-gradient(from 0deg at 50% 50%, #000 0 325deg, transparent 325deg 360deg); mask: conic-gradient(from 0deg at 50% 50%, #000 0 325deg, transparent 325deg 360deg); -webkit-transform: rotate(@r(0, 360)deg); transform: rotate(@r(0, 360)deg); opacity: @p(0, 1, 1); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box; } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
